title: CI
explain: Continuous integration runs your checks automatically on every push, so broken code is caught before it merges. For TypeScript that usually means installing dependencies, type-checking, and running the tests. GitHub Actions reads workflow files from `.github/workflows/`.
code:
name: ci
on: [push, pull_request]
jobs:
  check:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with: { node-version: 22 }
      - run: npm ci
      - run: npx tsc --noEmit
      - run: npm test
exercise: Add this workflow to a repository, push a change that breaks a type, and watch the check fail.
tip: Pin your Node version in CI to match the one you develop on, or a green build on your machine can fail there.
